NODE SAFETY: CENTRAL LIBRARY SETBACK (dashed) + 40 MAP-PX PROJECTION MARGIN. NODES / ROUTES / STATES ARE UGUI ONLY.
MODEL EXECUTION NOTES
1. This v03 supersedes v01/v02: their road / centre-library conflicts are audit references only. 2. Buildings use the listed replacement-boundary IDs; no baked gameplay markup.
3. Roads: R-01 W52, R-02 W48, R-03 W30, R-04 W28, R-05 W30, R-06 W28, T-01 W16, T-02 W15. Elevations: primary .27, secondary .235, trail .20.
4. Fixed geography only. Dynamic 40-node content, placement, routes, state, click bounds, drag and zoom are runtime UI projected through the same orthographic camera.
5. Render contract: 1536×864, Bilinear, 2×MSAA, no mipmaps; high-resolution blue/white hard surfaces, no Point scaling, pixelation, dithering, voxel treatment or toy rounding.
